#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <iomanip>

class InputReader {
public:
    std::istream& stream;
    char buffer[1024];
    int position;
    int limit;

    InputReader(std::istream& s) : stream(s), position(0), limit(0) {}

    int readInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (isSpace(c)) c = read();
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sign = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        int value = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw std::runtime_error("Input mismatch");
            value = value * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = read();
        } while (!isSpace(c));
        return value * sign;
    }

private:
    int read() {
        if (limit == -1) throw std::runtime_error("Input mismatch");
        if (position >= limit) {
            position = 0;
            stream.read(buffer, sizeof(buffer));
            limit = stream.gcount();
            if (limit <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return static_cast<unsigned char>(buffer[position++]);
    }

    static bool isSpace(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
    }
};

class Solver {
public:
    static const int N_MAX = 1 << 20;
    static double cosineArr[N_MAX];
    static double sineArr[N_MAX];
    static double negCosineArr[N_MAX];
    static double negSineArr[N_MAX];

    static void initialize() {
        for (int groupSize = 1; groupSize <= N_MAX; groupSize <<= 1) {
            int mid = groupSize >> 1;
            for (int i = mid; i < groupSize; i++) {
                double angle = 2 * M_PI * (i - mid) / groupSize;
                cosineArr[i] = cos(angle);
                sineArr[i] = sin(angle);
                negCosineArr[i] = cos(-angle);
                negSineArr[i] = sin(-angle);
            }
        }
    }

    void run(int testNum, InputReader& reader, std::ostream& writer) {
        const int MOD = 998244353;
        int n = reader.readInt();
        int k = reader.readInt();
        std::vector<int> vec(10, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int position = reader.readInt();
            vec[position] = 1;
        }

        std::vector<int> result = {1};
        int power = n / 2;

        while (true) {
            if ((power & 1) == 1) {
                result = multiply(result, vec, MOD);
            }
            power >>= 1;
            if (power == 0) break;
            vec = multiply(vec, vec, MOD);
        }

        long long total = 0;
        for (int val : result) {
            total += static_cast<long long>(val) * val;
        }
        writer << (total % MOD) << std::endl;
    }

private:
    std::vector<int> multiply(const std::vector<int>& A, const std::vector<int>& B, int mod) {
        int neededLength = A.size() + B.size() - 1;
        int N = std::max(2, 1 << (32 - __builtin_clz(neededLength - 1)));

        std::vector<double> realA(N, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> imagA(N, 0.0);
        for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int>(A.size()); i++) {
            int val = ((A[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
            realA[i] = val & 0x7FFF;
            imagA[i] = val >> 15;
        }
        fourierTransform(realA, imagA, false);

        std::vector<double> realB(N, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> imagB(N, 0.0);
        for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int>(B.size()); i++) {
            int val = ((B[i] % mod) + mod) % mod;
            realB[i] = val & 0x7FFF;
            imagB[i] = val >> 15;
        }
        fourierTransform(realB, imagB, false);

        std::vector<double> resReal(N, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> resImag(N, 0.0);

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            int j = (N - i) & (N - 1);
            double ar1 = (realA[i] + realA[j]) / 2;
            double ai1 = (imagA[i] - imagA[j]) / 2;
            double ar2 = (imagA[i] + imagA[j]) / 2;
            double ai2 = (realA[j] - realA[i]) / 2;

            double br1 = (realB[i] + realB[j]) / 2;
            double bi1 = (imagB[i] - imagB[j]) / 2;
            double br2 = (imagB[i] + imagB[j]) / 2;
            double bi2 = (realB[j] - realB[i]) / 2;

            resReal[i] = ar1 * br1 - ai1 * bi1 - ar2 * bi2 - ai2 * br2;
            resImag[i] = ar1 * bi1 + ai1 * br1 + ar2 * br2 - ai2 * bi2;
        }

        fourierTransform(resReal, resImag, true);
        std::vector<int> output(neededLength);
        for (int i = 0; i < neededLength; i++) {
            long long aa = llround(resReal[i]);
            long long bb = llround(resImag[i]);
            long long cc = llround(resImag[N - i]);
            output[i] = static_cast<int>((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod);
        }
        return output;
    }

    void fourierTransform(std::vector<double>& re, std::vector<double>& im, bool isInverse) {
        int n = re.size();
        int shift = 32 - __builtin_clz(n);
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int j = __builtin_bswap32(i << shift) >> shift;
            if (i < j) {
                std::swap(re[i], re[j]);
                std::swap(im[i], im[j]);
            }
        }

        for (int length = 2; length <= n; length <<= 1) {
            int half = length >> 1;
            int step = N_MAX / length;

            for (int groupStart = 0; groupStart < n; groupStart += length) {
                for (int pos = 0, w = 0; pos < half; pos++, w += step) {
                    double wReal = isInverse ? negCosineArr[half + pos] : cosineArr[half + pos];
                    double wImag = isInverse ? negSineArr[half + pos] : sineArr[half + pos];

                    int idx1 = groupStart + pos;
                    int idx2 = groupStart + pos + half;

                    double uRe = re[idx1];
                    double uIm = im[idx1];
                    double vRe = re[idx2] * wReal - im[idx2] * wImag;
                    double vIm = re[idx2] * wImag + im[idx2] * wReal;

                    re[idx1] = uRe + vRe;
                    im[idx1] = uIm + vIm;
                    re[idx2] = uRe - vRe;
                    im[idx2] = uIm - vIm;
                }
            }
        }

        if (isInverse) {
            double invN = 1.0 / n;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                re[i] *= invN;
                im[i] *= invN;
            }
        }
    }
};

double Solver::cosineArr[Solver::N_MAX];
double Solver::sineArr[Solver::N_MAX];
double Solver::negCosineArr[Solver::N_MAX];
double Solver::negSineArr[Solver::N_MAX];

int main() {
    Solver::initialize();
    InputReader reader(std::cin);
    Solver processor;
    processor.run(1, reader, std::cout);
    return 0;
}
